Effectiveness would trigger Exchange Act reporting requirements; the date remains subject to SEC review.
Company reaffirmed plans for national exchange listing

This is an early-stage corporate reporting and potential uplisting milestone, not a completed exchange listing. SEC review and Form 10 effectiveness must occur before reporting resumes and the company can advance its listing plans.
